entries.summary: WindowsCredentialManagerSecretStoreOptions loses commandRunner and systemRoot and gains optional koffi: the store calls Credential Manager in process and starts no PowerShell. A Host that passed commandRunner or systemRoot removes them. A packaged Host, which has no installed koffi, passes koffi: loadSdkKoffiAsset(nativeAssetRoot). The byok-pi-provider-launcher bin uses the default store options, so a single-file bundled Windows Host that runs it gets CREDENTIAL_MANAGER_UNAVAILABLE; that Host calls runPiProviderLauncher instead, with a createSecretStore that injects koffi. The entry format is unchanged.
